title: Microphone is off
note: One calm state with the microphone glyph: "The microphone is off". Type instead first, Open Settings quiet, Close at the top right. Only a refused permission lands here (S13). The browser denial is simulated by refusing getUserMedia; on a phone it is iOS's permission state, and "Open Settings" is native and does nothing on web.
text: Close The microphone is off Turn it on in Settings, or type this one. Type instead Open Settings
lines: Turn it on in Settings, or type this one.
